verdict.rationale: YYLO is a coding-agent orchestrator, so automatically opening a pull request when a task completes is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows a different delivery path: `finish` queues a committed candidate and `merge land` composes and lands it directly with ref protection. The GitHub integration only pulls issues into kanban and posts responses back to their thread. Nothing documents creating a pull request, on task completion or otherwise, so this is adjacent behavior with no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure an agent to automatically open a pull request when its task completes
